subject: Vendor onboarding playbook & schedule: Starlite AI — kickoff call
content:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rojas <elena@starlite.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding playbook & schedule: Starlite AI — kickoff call

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for inference. I work on Partner Ops and will kick off the vendor onboarding for Starlite AI. To get the procurement flow moving we typically do a 30–45 minute kickoff to align on:

- Mutual Action Plan (high-level milestones + owners)
- PO and invoicing process (who signs, timing, PO template)
- Required onboarding forms and evidence (W-9 / vendor questionnaire / SOC 2 scopes)
- Security/compliance touchpoints and handoff to R&D security if needed
- Success criteria & timeline (first production traffic, SLA expectations)

Are you available for either:
- Tue 2027-05-11 at 10:00–10:40 PT, or
- Wed 2027-05-12 at 14:00–14:40 PT

If neither works, share two alternative slots and we will adjust. I attached a short MAP template we use and a checklist we ask vendors to complete before activating Dedicated capacity.

CCing Laura (Finance ops) and Vivek (Onboarding lead) — they will own PO intake and vendor activation respectively.

Thanks,

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
priom@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: redwood_onboarding_map_v1.docx (DOCX, 45 KB); vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 12 KB)

----
From: Elena Rojas <elena@starlite.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-09T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding playbook & schedule: Starlite AI — kickoff call

Thanks, Priyom — happy to get this moving. Either slot works for us, prefer Tue at 10:00 PT.

Quick notes from Procurement: please include our procurement mailbox (procurement@starlite.ai) on the invite — they will want to review PO terms and our standard PO form (I attached an internal copy for your reference). Also, we generally need vendor banking info + signed W-9 before the first invoice.

Can you share the MAP link live (so we can comment)? Also looping in our procurement contact: Karen Lee (karen.lee@starlite.ai) — she will handle PO approvals.

Best,
Elena
Head of Partnerships, Starlite AI

Attachments: starlite_po_form.pdf (PDF, 68 KB)

----
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rojas <elena@starlite.ai>, procurement@starlite.ai
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-10T08:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding playbook & schedule: Starlite AI — kickoff call

Great — locking Tue 2027-05-11 10:00–10:40 PT. Calendar invite to follow.

Agenda draft (30–40 min):
1) Quick intros (5 min) — Redwood + Starlite stakeholders
2) MAP walkthrough (10 min) — milestones, owners, dates (I will share doc live)
3) PO & billing process (8 min) — Laura to confirm invoicing cadence / required fields on PO
4) Onboarding forms & security evidence (8 min) — Neha to outline SOC2 scope and required docs
5) Activation timeline and success criteria (5 min) — agree on first production pass, SLA target, and rollback plan
6) Next steps & action owners (2–4 min)

I created a live MAP doc here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aB_MAP_example — please add comments directly. HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/987654/ST-4921-PO (deal owner: Priyom).

Attachments included: vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx; redwood_onboarding_map_v1.docx.

Neha — can you prepare a short list of the minimum security artifacts we need before activation (SOC 2 scope, data retention policy excerpt, and any encryption/KMS requirements)? Vivek — please confirm ownership of the activation checklist and the expected time from completed forms -> activation.

Thanks,
Priyom

----
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Elena Rojas <elena@starlite.ai>, procurement@starlite.ai
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-10T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding playbook & schedule: Starlite AI — kickoff call

Thanks team — one small addition to the agenda: please include a short discussion on PO payment terms and invoicing contacts. We need Starlite to confirm:
- Remit address for invoice
- Invoice contact (name + email)
- Standard payment terms (Net 30 / Net 45) or special cadence

Vivek: can you take the PO intake step? I will validate billing fields once Starlite returns their PO form.

Priyom / Elena: if you want, we can add a 10-minute optional follow-up with Finance after the main call for deeper billing questions.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

----
From: Elena Rojas <elena@starlite.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, procurement@starlite.ai
Date: 2027-05-10T09:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding playbook & schedule: Starlite AI — kickoff call

Perfect — Tue 10:00 PT confirmed. I added Karen Lee (karen.lee@starlite.ai) to this thread.

I reviewed the MAP and checklist quickly — this looks aligned. A few success criteria from our side:
- Redwood submits initial PO within 3 business days of call (or provide invoice instructions)
- Vendor onboarding checklist fully completed within 7 business days
- First production traffic for our pilot by 2027-06-01

We attached our standard PO form (starlite_po_form.pdf) in case you want to pre-fill any fields. Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Elena

Attachments: starlite_po_form.pdf
